verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the browser pane's Design mode, which lets you select an element and send a requested change to an agent with element context. That conveys visual intent, but not through an attached screenshot or mockup. Nothing in the pack shows image attachments on tasks or prompts. Missing for 10: attaching screenshots or mockups to a task, annotation or markup of images, evidence that agents receive image input through Superset, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
